description: This file contains configuration path resolution functions for the openclaw project, including environment variable handling, directory and file path computations, and port parsing.

methods.name: resolveIsNixMode
methods.description: Determines if the environment is in Nix mode based on OPENCLAW_NIX_MODE environment variable.

methods.name: resolveLegacyStateDir
methods.description: Returns the first legacy state directory or the new state directory if none exist.

methods.name: resolveNewStateDir
methods.description: Returns the path to the new state directory.

methods.name: resolveStateDir
methods.description: Determines the appropriate state directory, considering overrides and existing directories.

methods.name: resolveCanonicalConfigPath
methods.description: Returns the canonical path to the configuration file, considering environment overrides.

methods.name: resolveConfigPathCandidate
methods.description: Returns the preferred existing configuration file path among candidates.

methods.name: resolveConfigPath
methods.description: Returns the active configuration file path, preferring existing files.

methods.name: resolveDefaultConfigCandidates
methods.description: Provides a list of default configuration file path candidates.

methods.name: resolveGatewayLockDir
methods.description: Returns the directory for gateway lock files, based on temp directory and UID.

methods.name: resolveOAuthDir
methods.description: Returns the directory for OAuth credentials storage, considering environment overrides.

methods.name: resolveOAuthPath
methods.description: Returns the full path to the OAuth credentials file.

methods.name: parseGatewayPortEnvValue
methods.description: Parses environment variable value for gateway port, supporting various formats.

methods.name: resolveGatewayPort
methods.description: Determines the gateway port from environment, config, or default.
